title: 1Password app data
whyItMatters: 1Password keeps its local database, cache and account state in this group container. It shows the app was used on this Mac and may hold account metadata even while the vault is locked.
source: 1Password Support, If you can't install, update, or use 1Password: Mac app data under ~/Library/Group Containers/2BUA8C4S2C.com.1password/Library/Application Support/1Password - https://support.1password.com/configure-antivirus/
notes: The encrypted database and app data live in the group container. UI data may also sit under ~/Library/Application Support/1Password. Nothing is opened or decrypted.

cleanup.exportFirst: Confirm you can sign in to your 1Password account, have the Secret Key and Emergency Kit, and export any vault you need.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of 1Password on this Mac and remove this device from the authorized devices in your account settings.
steps: Confirm the account sign-in details and Emergency Kit are available.
Export the vaults you need and check that the export opens.
Sign out of 1Password and remove this device from the account.
If you decide to remove the app, move 1Password from Applications to the Trash.
Delete the 1Password folder named in the plan only after the export is confirmed.
cleanup.risk: Removes the local 1Password database and settings from this Mac. Items that are only in the account stay in the cloud.
